stem: Explain how the graph shows that on average the growth rate for girls slows down after 12 years of age.
correctAnswer: The line for females becomes less steep (the gradient decreases) after age 12, meaning the height is increasing more slowly — i.e. the growth rate slows down.
steps: Look at the slope of the female line before and after age 12
Before age 12: the female line rises steeply
After age 12: the female line becomes flatter (less steep)
A flatter slope = slower rate of height increase = slower growth rate

rubric.description: States that the female curve becomes less steep or flatter after age 12
Explicitly links the reduced steepness to slower growth rate, using gradient, slope, or rate of change language, or by comparing height gains before and after age 12

rating.description: Clear explanation referencing the reduced slope or gradient of the female curve after age 12
Correct observation about the curve flattening but without clearly linking to growth rate
Incorrect or irrelevant explanation (e.g. refers to females being shorter than males rather than the growth rate)
